violations.why: The ISR can increment global_var between main's two reads, so the store at line 32 and the load at line 34 use different indices.
When i==2, main writes array[2] at line 38. The ISR can overwrite it at line 47 before main reads array[2] at line 42, so main does not read back the value it wrote.
